substeps.caption: A storage tray: what the arm picks from. 1760 x 760 mm and 300 mm tall. Nothing here draws power: no UPS, no dock, no cameras; the bay's overhead camera sees it whenever it is presented.
Charge cups turned from 5N Al (blue rack) and C10100 Cu (orange rack), 48 of each, in the front rows where a level gripper takes them.
Their plugs, Al and Cu apart; 54 capped 20 mL vials; 112 15 mL ICP-MS tubes.
The top drawer: 96 SEM pin stubs, 12.7 mm, carbon tabs on.
The lower drawer: 32 polished 1.25 in mounts.
Tensile bars (E8 sub-size), sealed 250 mL powder jars, labelled bins. Every jar is clear glass with a black cap.
Tinted for now: which powder is in which jar (legend, top right).
The tint is only a highlight, held for a few seconds...
...then it fades back to plain glass and black caps.
Every pocket is a seat: storage_seats() lists them for the arm's planner.
